title: ProCD v. Zeidenberg — as discussed in Hill and Klocek
shortTitle: ProCD v. Zeidenberg — as discussed in Hill and Klocek
summary: The two principal opinions give competing significance to ProCD’s box-term formation analysis.
notes:
Casebook discussion of a shorter authority.

Hill applies its review-and-return approach beyond software. Klocek criticizes its treatment of § 2-207 and automatic identification of the vendor as offeror. The standalone ProCD opinion is not supplied as an assigned principal case here; the entry records the use of the decision in the assigned excerpts.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 294–302. Open assigned page 294.
